item.title: Yokote Kamakura Snow Festival: Glowing Snow Huts — Akita Guide
item.description: Yokote’s Kamakura Festival fills the city with hundreds of dome-shaped snow huts — children sit inside eating mochi and offering amazake (sweet sake) to visitors who bow to enter through the small opening. After dark, candles within each kamakura glow amber through the snow walls, creating one of Japan’s most magical winter scenes. 🗓️ At a Glance Location Yokote, Akita Hours Feb 15–16, evenings best Admission Free (small donation inside huts) Time needed 1.
